title.vi: Lệnh Di chuyển chủ động (Đường dùng chung) 2018
title.th: คำสั่งการเคลื่อนที่เชิงรุก (ทางร่วม) 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 3 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Shared Paths) Order 2018 and comes into operation on 1 May 2018.

3.—(1) A path on State land that —
(a)is surfaced with bituminous surfacing material, asphalt, concrete or pavers;
(aa) is either —
(i)demarcated with a red or yellow line (whether continuous or broken) of 100 millimetres in width; or
(ii)red, blue, green or yellow in colour, or coated with a dark grey fibre reinforced polymer cement coating;
[S 469/2020 wef 18/06/2020]
[S 470/2025 wef 01/07/2025]
(b)is usually at least 2 metres but not more than 4 metres in width; and
(c)is specified or described in the First Schedule,
is each declared to be a shared path for the purposes of the Act.
(2) A path on HDB land that —
(a)is surfaced with bituminous surfacing material, asphalt, concrete or pavers;
(aa) is either —
(i)demarcated with a red or yellow line (whether continuous or broken) of 100 millimetres in width; or
(ii)red, blue, green or yellow in colour, or coated with a dark grey fibre reinforced polymer cement coating;
[S 469/2020 wef 18/06/2020]
[S 470/2025 wef 01/07/2025]
(b)is usually at least one metre but not more than 4 metres in width; and
(c)is specified or described in the Second Schedule,
is each declared to be a shared path for the purposes of the Act.
(3) A path on land vested in or under the control or management of the National Parks Board that —
(a)is surfaced with bituminous surfacing material, asphalt, concrete or pavers;
(aa)if the path abuts on a footpath, is demarcated with a red or yellow line (whether continuous or broken) of 100 millimetres in width;
[S 469/2020 wef 18/06/2020]
(ab)if the path abuts on a pedestrian‑only path, is demarcated with a continuous red line of 100 millimetres in width;
[S 709/2022 wef 31/08/2022]
(b)is usually at least 2.5 metres but not more than 6 metres in width; and
(c)is specified or described in the Third Schedule,
is each declared to be a shared path for the purposes of the Act.
[S 51/2020 wef 18/01/2020]
